content.comment_body: Good evening, everyone. I'm currently working on a project where I need to display a web browser interface in one of my PLCs. I've created several pages that can be navigated via the web server using my PC's browser, but whenever I move from the home page to another, the animation images configured in [product_name] Web Editor do not appear. Instead, I see the digital value of my variable (1 or 0) in the browser. I'd appreciate any guidance on what I might be doing incorrectly. Regards,
Which version of [product_name] are you using? Could you provide a screenshot of your login screen?
Hello and thanks for your reply. I've attached some screenshots of the interface. The [product_name] details for this project are: Reference: [article_no], Firmware: [version_no]. Regards,
Could you upload your [product_name] Web Editor project and your [product_name] program as a ZIP file?
Good morning. I've attached the requested file to this post. Thank you very much.
It looks like this is only the [product_name] Web Editor project. Could you also provide the [product_name] program?
Apologies, here's the program file as well.

It appears there may be an issue with your [product_name] Web Editor project. I noticed that I can't save the project directly to the SD card via the Web Editor if the SD card is inside the PLC. When I insert the SD card into the PC and transfer the project to it, everything works. After inserting the SD card into the PLC and launching the extended web server, the pages and animated images display as expected, and the buttons function correctly. However, I am using the most recent [product_name] Web Editor version, so I needed to upgrade your older project to get it working.

analysis.insight_summary: The user tried to show animated images on web pages created with [product_name] Web Editor, but only saw digital variable values after page navigation. Troubleshooting revealed the issue was related to how the project and SD card were managed, and that compatibility with Web Editor versions played a role. Upgrading the project and properly transferring it to the SD card resolved the animation and display issues.
analysis.user_expectations: The user expects animated images produced in [product_name] Web Editor to appear properly and consistently across different web pages when using the web interface.
